escapes.plausible_wrong_implementation: Repair malformed characters through ordered replacements so a newly produced valid character is matched by a later replacement and corrupted again.

literal_case.observed: Single-pass exact-head repair changes only the malformed marker and preserves existing valid Unicode accents.

sibling_cases.observed: média combined with a malformed marker preserves the original é.

prevention_change.evidence: Migration uses one-pass translate with ambiguous valid Unicode codepoints excluded; runtime helper maps only characters matching the unambiguous marker predicate.

detection_change.evidence: Focused helper and migration tests include mixed-validity and valid-Unicode preservation cases.

escapes.plausible_wrong_implementation: Let a critical handoff define custom risk-family names and declare itself saturated without enumerating or validating the canonical contract.

literal_case.observed: Exact-head rebuilt manifest enumerates the canonical family set and binds applicable surfaces to attack controls.

sibling_cases.observed: Omitting a canonical family is rejected by the risk-saturation validator.
An applicable surface without a matching adversarial control is rejected.

prevention_change.evidence: Risk saturation is generated from the canonical initializer instead of a hand-authored family vocabulary.

detection_change.evidence: validate_risk_saturation.py is executed before terminal handoff and checks canonical families, applicability, surfaces and controls.
